name: @vexa/stt-live
description: Streaming realtime STT engine for the mixed lane: one live session (vLLM Voxtral realtime WS, or audio.cpp HTTP-live) streams model-committed transcript deltas; segments finalize on sentence/silence boundaries and are named by the shared hints binder. No submit/confirm loop.
